Patch Set 1:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good: this turns a client-triggerable LBUG into an error return, and the error path reuses the existing lod_striping_free() cleanup. The notes inline are optional and can wait for a refresh that happens anyway; there's no need to re-spin for them. A regression test would help, e.g. an open(O_CREAT|O_WRONLY) on MDT0 using a FID from MDT1's sequence, which crashes the MDS without this patch and returns -EINVAL with it. Separately (pre-existing and out of scope here): mdt_new_fid_check() accepts any MDT sequence, so an open-create without write intent (striped == 0) can still create a regular file on a remote MDT. Should regular-file creates be limited to local FIDs in the MDT?

commit.message:
LU-20923 lod: reject a remote striped create with no layout

lod_declare_striped_create() cannot select OST objects for a remote
object, so the caller must supply the stripe layout (lovea), which
normally happens only during migrate (mdd_migrate_create).  Return
-EINVAL when the layout is absent, so a remote striped create with no
layout fails cleanly instead of proceeding without one.

Signed-off-by: Andreas Dilger <adilger@thelustrecollective.com>
